title: Vinarayya – M. Devadas Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: వినరయ్య వినరయ్య – యేసు ప్రభావము – గనరయ్య క్రీస్తుని
ఘన కార్యంబు = మనసు యేసుని కథపై – మలపి యోచించిన
కుసుమ రోగియైన – కోమలి యొకరు నీ – రసమై పోవుచు మిగుల
వ్యసన పడుచుండెన్ = బస విడిచి దారిలో – ప్రభు యేసునిన్ జూడ – నిసు
పన్నెండేండ్ల నుండి – పరమ వైద్యుల యొద్ద మందు బుచ్చుకొనిన
మానదాయె = ఇన్నాళ్ళకీ వేళ – యేసు చెంగు ముట్ట – నిడుమ
తన జబ్బు పోవును – అని యామె యనుకొన్న – అనుకొనుట
విశ్వాస – మాయె ముదిరి = అనుకొన్నట్టే జబ్బు – అంతర్దానమాయె
english: Vinarayya vinarayya – Yesu prabhavamu – ganarayya Kreesthuni
Ghana karyambu = manasu Yesuni kathapai – malapi yochinchina
Mahima kanabadu neeku anubhavamu doraku || Vinarayya ||
Kusuma rogiyaina – komali yokaru nee – rasamai povuchu migula
Vyasana paduchunden = basa vidichi daarilo – Prabhu Yesunin jooda – nisu
Pannendendla nundi – parama vaidyula yoddha mandu bucchukonina
Maanadaayen = innaallakee velha – Yesu chengu mutta – nidu
Tana jabbu povunu – ani yaame yanukonna – anukonuta
Viswaasa – maaye mudiri = anukonnatte jabbu – anthardaanamaaye
translation: Listen, O people, listen to the greatness and majesty of Jesus! Behold the mighty works of Christ!
If you turn your mind toward the story of Jesus and ponder upon it,
His divine glory will be revealed to you, and you shall gain a personal experience of Him.
A delicate woman who suffered from a continuous disease (bleeding/infirmity) was becoming extremely weak and filled with sorrow.
Leaving her dwelling place, she went out on the path to see Lord Jesus,
Without harboring even the slightest grain of doubt in her heart.
For twelve long years, despite taking medicine from various grand physicians, her sickness was never cured.
Yet today, the moment she touched the hem of Jesus’ garment,
She received total deliverance and freedom from all her distress and suffering.
“My illness will surely leave me,” she thought within herself—and that simple thought grew into profound, deep faith.
Just as she believed, her sickness completely vanished!
Is it ever hard to simply believe and trust, rather than living in fear and anxiety?

credits.Vocals: Dr. P. Sajeeva Rao, Jeeva R. Pakerla

intro: Vinarayya is the latest Telugu Christian song, written by M. Devadas Ayyagaru, sung by Dr. P. Sajeeva Rao, Jeeva R. Pakerla and music composed by Jonah Samuel. This song was released on May 05, 2026, through Jeeva R. Pakerla YouTube Channel.
